sources.title: D3 Turbo - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: D3 Turbo is the upgraded 27B multimodal decision model in vLLM Semantic Router's Decision 3.0 family. Given text, JSON, images, or video alongside a set of named questions, it answers each with a probability instead of generated text, supporting choice, yes/no, score, box localization, and tracking questions in a single forward pass.
